title: A rating lift can steal control sales
hook: Two stated cases: explore the control displacement inflating a measured sales contrast.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the control displacement inflating a measured sales contrast affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines MeasuredGap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the control displacement inflating a measured sales contrast in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
